originalText: Interview Presentation for Graduate Cloud Engineer
IT graduate seeking a first graduate role with background as a Graduate Data Analyst.
Hello, my name is Fictional Acceptance Candidate. I am an IT graduate seeking my first graduate role.
Developed an Academic Sales Dashboard as a Student Developer using SQL and Python.
Queried sample sales data with SQL and prepared charts for an academic project.
In my academic sales dashboard project, I worked with SQL and Python to query sample sales data and prepare a chart.
Applied skills in SQL and Python during academic coursework.
Academic project used synthetic data with no commercial outcomes or cloud deployment.
My foundational skills include SQL and Python. My project focused on academic synthetic data without commercial outcomes or cloud deployment.
Role Alignment and Honestly Calibrated Gaps
Applying for the Graduate Cloud Engineer position to transition my programming and data skills.
Acknowledging that my current experience lacks AWS deployment, Terraform, and Kubernetes operations.

For the Graduate Cloud Engineer role, I want to be transparent about my background. While I bring Python and SQL experience from my academic dashboard project, I honestly acknowledge that I do not yet have hands-on experience with AWS deployment, Terraform infrastructure, or Kubernetes operations.
